content.title: R13 (Residential 13) District
content.summary: The R13 (Residential 13) District is designated for new residential developments with a density of up to thirteen units per acre, allowing various housing types such as single-family homes, duplexes, and multifamily units. The district includes specific use classifications with allowances for residential, commercial, community, and utility uses, each categorized as allowed by-right, limited, or conditional, with additional regulations outlined in the Land Development Code.
content.body:
Intended to allow for new residential development of a variety of housing products up to a density of thirteen (13) units per acre.

Acronyms:

- Allowed Use By-Right (A)
- Limited Use (L)
- Conditional Use (C)

**Note**: If a use is not listed in the table then it is not allowed in the zoning district

| --- | --- | --- |
| Single-Family Detached | A | N/A |
| Duplex | L | 3-1-3-2 |
| Townhome | L | 3-1-3-2 |
| Multiplex | A | N/A |
| Multifamily | A | N/A |
| Cottages, Micro-Homes, or Co-Housing | A | N/A |
| Boarding, Lodging, or Rooming House | L | 3-1-3-3 |
| Group Home, FFHA | L | 3-1-3-3 |
| Group Home for Juvenile Offenders | C | 3-1-3-3 |
| Group Home, Not Specified Above | C | 3-1-3-3 |
| Live-Work Unit | L | 3-1-3-3 |
